question: Find the surface area of a sphere whose diameter is equal to 22 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The surface area of a sphere can be calculated directly using its diameter (d).

Surface Area = π × d²

Given d = 22 cm

Surface Area = π × 22² = 484π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 484π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 

 

 
• 
 
 r = 11 cm
 Diameter (d) = 22 cm
 Sphere

**Given:**

Diameter of the sphere (d) = 22 cm

Radius of the sphere (r) = 22 ÷ 2 = 11 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of a sphere = 4 × π × r²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (11)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × 121

⇒ Surface Area = 484π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 484π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The volume represents the total space occupied inside the sphere. Formula: V = (4 ÷ 3) × π × r³.

Hemisphere Surface Areas

The Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a hemisphere is exactly half of a full sphere: 2 × π × r². The Total Surface Area (TSA) includes the flat circular base, making it 3 × π × r².

Volume of a Hemisphere

A hemisphere is exactly half of a full sphere. Its volume is exactly half: V = (2 ÷ 3) × π × r³.
